svg.title: How Grayscale’s ZCSH ETP actually works
svg.desc: Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust to ZCSH, an exchange-traded product holding ZEC. Grayscale sponsors the fund, Coinbase Custody safekeeps the ZEC, and BNY administers the fund. Jane Street Capital and Virtu Americas create and redeem share baskets. Investors buy and sell ZCSH shares on NYSE Arca through brokerage accounts. AP redemptions are cash only under the August 24, 2026 prospectus. Investors hold shares, not ZEC in a personal wallet.

g.aria-label: A third-party investment product holding real ZEC.
AP redemption: cash only under the Aug 24, 2026 prospectus.
Zcash is the network behind the asset.
Sources: Grayscale product page · SEC prospectus, Aug 24, 2026
ETP = exchange-traded product. “The Zcash ETF” is the product name; it is not a 1940 Act registered fund.
